title: The lost-work check skips named record branches (roadmap and any branch a repo names as its record branch)
why: The check lists the record branch as a lost-work row every run, though it has no PR and is never merged, so a real row is scrolled past.
source: Lane lost-work-sweep (session_013NEJL1rADjupx82bXheSsB) via the coordinator, 15:29 CST Nov 13.
note: Filed 15:30 CST Nov 13. Small code. State f (merge/merge.py `lost_work_branches`, after PR #3170 merges) lists the record branch `roadmap` (no PR, thousands of commits ahead of main) as a recurring false row. Skip named record branches. Order: test-author red case first (an f row for a no-PR branch that is a named record branch lists no row; an ordinary no-PR branch still lists), then builder, reviewer.
